title.zh: 5月20日北京部分地區正式實施戒嚴
title.en: 20 May: martial law takes effect in parts of Beijing

summary.zh: 5 月 19 日深夜首都黨政軍幹部大會召開後，國務院總理李鵬簽署命令，宣布自 1989 年 5 月 20 日上午十時起在北京市部分地區實施戒嚴，並調集外地部隊向北京周邊開進。這是五月對峙局勢轉向軍事戒備的重大轉折。
summary.en: Following a late-night leadership meeting on 19 May, Premier Li Peng signed the decree imposing martial law in parts of Beijing starting at 10:00 a.m. on 20 May 1989, as outside army units were ordered to deploy toward the capital.
